question: Who was the captain of India’s Under-19 Women’s cricket team that won the inaugural edition of the Women’s Under-19 T-20 World Cup in January 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shafali Verma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Shafali Verma** was the **captain of India’s** **Under-19 Women’s** cricket team that** won** the inaugural edition of the Women’s Under-19** T-20 World Cup** in January 2023. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• For the** first time**, the** Indian women's team** has been successful in **winning any ICC tournament**.
 
• Indian player **Shweta Sehrawat** scored the** most runs** in the Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup 2023.
 
• She scored 292 runs in 6 matches.
 
• **Player of the match** in the **final** - **Tita Sadhu**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 2023 ICC** Under-19 Women's T20 World Cup** was hosted by **South Africa**. 
 
• England captain **Grace Scrivens** has been named **Player of the Tournament**.
 
• The **2024 Under-19 men’s T-20 World Cup** will be hosted by **Sri Lanka**.
